title: Tech Lead (.NET)
description:
Se você gosta de liderar times, orientar tecnicamente, tomar decisões que movem o projeto e ainda colocar a mão no código quando necessário, essa oportunidade de Tech Lead .NET é a sua chance de criar impacto real e escalar produtos de verdade!


Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?


Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa.

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server, incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD, testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento.

- Boa comunicação, com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP
description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Estamos com uma oportunidade para o nosso time corporativo para: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP


Experiência Profissional


Inglês fluente ou avançado para escrita e conversação - Obrigatório


Requisitos


  • Excelente conhecimento em desenvolvimento ABAP no S/4, incluindo Steampunk e conceitos de SAP Clean Core
  • Conhecimento em criação de CDS Views , ODATA & REST e integração orientada por APIs .
  • Experiência em ABAP on S/4 HANA de 3 a 4 anos – CDS , AMDP (ABAP Managed Database Procedures) e table functions , RAP Framework (RESTful Application Programming)
  • Habilidades de integração no S/4 usando Rest API e SProxy
  • Experiência com Adobe Forms
  • Conhecimento do processo SolMan Charm
  • Conhecimento em pesquisa de SAP Notes como parte do tratamento de defeitos. Registrar OSS-cases na SAP e instalar SAP Notes
  • Conhecimento em instalação e/ou ativação de versões de países do S/4
  • Conhecimento em instalação de namespaces para integração com sistemas legais
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado para escrita e conversação - Obrigatório
  • Conhecimento em tributação do Brasil
  • Conhecimento em tributação do Peru e do Chile será um diferencial
  • Espanhol será um diferencial


Formação Acadêmica


  • Graduação completa.


Modelo de trabalho:


  • Remoto


CLT

Benefícios CLT:

Vale Refeição

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Solution Architect/ Technical Architect
description:
Position : Solution Architect/ Technical Architect

Location : Brazil - Remote

Duration: 12+ months

Rate : DOE


15+ years of IT experience and minimum of 10+ years using public cloud offerings such as Microsoft Azure, Azure Migrate, Azure SQL IaaS/PaaS, Azure Storage , Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM

Primary skills:

  • Demonstrates a high level of proficiency and hands-on expertise in delivering high quality designs using Architecture frameworks
  • Conducting AS-IS assessments of applications, designing target state architecture, and obtaining approvals from client architecture review board.
  • Expertise in On-prem/Public cloud Infra assessments using Azure Migrate
  • Driving the cloud Solutioning Azure activities for large complex migration
  • Ensure that the proposed solution covers Azure strategy, stakeholder management as well as the actual solution covering Business, Application and Infrastructure as well as commercial aspects (in terms of value for money and not commercial costing etc.)
  • Working experience with various industry domains like banking, healthcare, Insurance
  • Understanding customer Infra landscape. Design and build Azure Landing Zone activities
  • Provide the Azure target architecture and its BoM pricing and licensing related details
  • Azure Target Solutions architect Diagram (all Azure services) including HLD & LLD
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure & Windows environments (Processor, networking, clusters, IO, memory etc. related issues)

Secondary Skills:

  • Design infrastructure/Data storage solutions
  • Design business continuity/DR solutions
  • Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
  • Work with Internal stakeholders, Customer stakeholders and Project Managers to understand the migration requirements and provide solutions accordingly

Certifications (Good to have)

  • AZ-305: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions
  • AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner, we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting‑edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.

We are looking for a talented and motivated UX/UI Designer to join our UX team. If you are proactive, organized, and passionate about creating exceptional user experiences, we want to meet you!


Responsibilities

• UX Research: Conduct research using techniques such as desk research, user and stakeholder interviews, benchmarking, surveys, persona creation, user journeys, empathy maps, user flows, sitemaps, and more.

• Perform tests such as user testing, shadowing, field research, tree testing, and A/B testing to generate valuable insights during project discovery.

• UI Design: Develop low-, medium-, and high-fidelity prototypes, creating visually appealing and functional interfaces aligned with user and project needs.


Requirements

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in UX and UI projects.

• Intermediate English for conversation is required.

• Spanish is considered a plus.


Skills

• Strong experience in UX Research and UI Design.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Excellent communication skills to present ideas and collaborate with different stakeholders.

• Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Miro, Maze, and others.

• Strategic thinking, context awareness, and ability to adapt solutions to project needs.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Colaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

title: Financial Institutions Partnership Director
description:
Job Description

●Build up strategic partnership with major financial institutions in the respective regions/business line, nurturing business collaboration with global banks and other financial institutions to enhance the company services on providing payment, collection and other services that is related to B2B verticals and merchants growth.

●Develop and execute channel partnership strategy through identifying the potential partners, negotiating, closing partnership deals, implementing, and managing complex partnership engagements.

●Ensure project deliverable in terms of channel integration and optimisation are executed with quality and timely.

●Review process gaps, identify areas for improvement and drive the payment optimisation. ●Manage partnerships to review success factors and hold periodic meetings to discuss sales & marketing strategies, lead-gen, and new products/features.

●Research on the business model and compliance policy of oversea funds management practice in local market.



The Successful Applicant:

●Min 5 years of working experience in collaboration with local financial institution or payment channel industry.

●In-depth understanding on local regulation and compliance regarding payment business and cross border fund movement.

●Experience in negotiation and partnership proposal development

●Ability to maintain high efficiency across different countries

●Solid interpersonal skills, logical thinking and analytical skills

●Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities, enjoys working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

title: Consultor Óptico
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. A empresa reúne a expertise complementar de dois pioneiros da indústria, um em tecnologias avançadas de lentes e outro na arte da fabricação de óculos icônicos, criando um negócio verticalmente integrado, única e exclusivamente posicionado para atender às necessidades de visão em constante evolução do mundo e à demanda global de uma indústria de óculos em crescimento. Com mais de 180.000 colaboradores em 150 países impulsionando nossas marcas icônicas, nossas pessoas são criativas, empreendedoras e reconhecidas por suas perspectivas e individualidades únicas. Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a \"verem mais e serem mais\" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo.


Responsabilidades da posição:

  • Contatar, prospectar e visitar clientes;
  • Divulgar e gerar demanda de vendas de produtos e serviços para a empresa;
  • Elaborar junto com o gestor um planejamento de visitas mensal;
  • Ministrar treinamentos com clientes;
  • Realizar manutenção de carteira de clientes, atualizando-as sempre que necessário;
  • Promover o aumento de vendas dentro da sua carteira de clientes;
  • Buscar informações de mercado a fim de identificar clientes com potencial, e possíveis ameaças da concorrência;
  • Elaborar relatório diário de visitas no sistema;
  • Alcançar as metas propostas;
  • Acompanhar a performance dos clientes para construir planos de ação com base nesses resultados;
  • Reforçar campanhas e capacitar as lojas para que vendam mais e melhor os nossos produtos.


Requisitos da posição:

  • Graduação completa ou cursando;
  • Interesse no segmento óptico;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Carteira de habilitação (B) definitiva;
  • Conhecimentos do Pacote Office;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Boa capacidade analítica.


*A Essilorluxottica valoriza e apoia a diversidade, por esse motivo, todas as nossas vagas são abertas para candidaturas de profissionais PCDs.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Java & Node.js
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Java & Node.js)

Location: Remote – Brazil

Employment Type: Full-time

Salary: Negotiable


About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with strong experience in Java-based distributed systems , stream-based processing , and Node.js services . In this role, you will design, build, and operate backend services that handle high-throughput workloads , integrate with cloud platforms , and support business-critical applications .

You will work closely with architects, product teams, and other engineers while leveraging modern infrastructure and CI/CD tooling, including Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, AWS, and GCP .

Key Responsibilities


  • Design, implement, and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Node.js
  • Build and optimize message-driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka
  • Develop scalable, resilient APIs and backend services
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following industry best practices
  • Deploy, monitor, and support applications running on Kubernetes across cloud environments
  • Collaborate with architects and product teams to design system components and integrations
  • Participate in code reviews, system design discussions, and operational readiness activities
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across services and infrastructure
  • Prototype and evaluate new technologies to reduce costs and increase engineering velocity


Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong experience with Java in backend or distributed systems environments
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, topics, offsets, stream processing)
  • Proficiency in Node.js for backend application development
  • Experience deploying and maintaining services on Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP
  • Solid understanding of software design patterns, system architecture, and microservices principles
  • Experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL , including schema design, performance tuning, and migrations
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a distributed/remote team environment


Nice to Have

  • Experience with VOD / Streaming platforms
  • Basic React experience (frontend integration, state/context management, UI components)
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Helm, etc.)
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog or New Relic

We are looking for a Front-End Engineering Technical Lead  to own the design, architecture, and implementation of our user interfaces  across web and mobile experiences. This is a hands-on role  with strong emphasis on coding, design quality, and technical decision-making , not just coordination.


You will work directly with Product Management and UI/UX  to translate product vision into scalable, performant, and intuitive user interfaces, while setting engineering standards and best practices for the front-end stack. This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys building, shaping architecture, while staying deeply involved in implementation.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadershiop & Architecture

  • Own the front-end architecture  for web and mobile applications.
  • Make technical design decisions  around frameworks, components, state management, performance, and scalability.
  • Define and enforce front-end best practices , coding standards, and UI consistency.


Hands-On Development

  • Design and implement complex, high-quality UI components.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and high-performance user interfaces.
  • Lead by example through significant individual code contributions.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product  to refine requirements and scope.
  • Work directly with UI/UX  to ensure design fidelity and usability.
  • Translate product and design concepts into technical solutions.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of front-end engineering experience , with at least 1+ years in a technical leadership role
  • Strong experience with Angular  (required).

title: Cientista de Dados - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Cientista de Dados - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você :

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Conhecimentos:

  • Programação;
  • Tratamento de Dados.

Linguagens:

  • Python;
  • PySpark;
  • SQL.

Ferramentas:

Big Data:

  • HUE;
  • Hive;
  • Spark (SparkML);
  • NIFI.

Banco de Dados:

  • DB2;
  • MySQL;
  • Oracle;
  • Dbeaver (Ferramenta de Consulta).
  • Modelagem de Dados (Erwin)
  • Versionamento de código (Git)

Dashboards:

  • Spotfire;
  • Power BI.

Ciência de Dados

  • Manipulação de Dados;
  • Visualização de Dados;
  • Estatística;
  • Modelagem Preditiva;
  • Inteligência Artificial
  • IA Generativa
  • Machine Learning.

title: Projetista de Produto
description:
A STEP é uma empresa de engenharia especializada no setor automotivo, reconhecida por sua excelência técnica e compromisso com a inovação. Fundada em 1992, a empresa estabeleceu sua sede em Turim, cidade considerada o centro do desenvolvimento automotivo na Itália.

Com o objetivo de expandir sua atuação e atender melhor às demandas regionais, a STEP inaugurou em 2004 a unidade Step do Sul , localizada em Pomigliano, na província de Nápoles.

Em 2009, dando continuidade ao seu plano de internacionalização, a empresa investiu na América Latina, o que resultou na abertura de uma Sede também em Contagem (Minas Gerais, Brasil) , ampliando sua presença no mercado global.


Estamos a procura de Projetistas de Produto Pleno e Sênior.


Áreas:

  • Body in White;
  • Closures;
  • Internal Trims;
  • External Trims;


Formação:

  • Engenharia mecânica, Mecatrônica ou Produção.
  • Técnico em Mecânica ou Mecatrônica.


Requisitos:

  • 5 anos ou mais de experiência como projetista de desenvolvimento de produto nas áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de peças plásticas;
  • Conhecimento e domínio dos softwares CATIA V5 ou Unigraphics NX (testes poderão ser aplicados durante o processo);
  • Oportunidades para desenvolvimento de atividades de forma remota / híbrida e presencial.
  • Desejável: Inglês Avançado (Não Mandatório);

title: Suporte Python Tech Ops
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Solucionar problemas de suporte e solicitações técnicas relacionadas a sistemas de produção.
  • Conduzir análises técnicas aprofundadas de incidentes, realizando investigações.
  • Monitorar, relatar e solucionar problemas de pipeline de dados e sistemas de back-end
  • Analisar fluxos de trabalho e criar relatórios de defeitos / falhas detalhados

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Proficiência em depuração de problemas técnicos;
  • Proficiente em SQL e familiarizado com ecossistemas de Big Data como Cassandra, Flink, Kafka e outras tecnologias relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento de scripts com Python ou linguagens similares para automatizar tarefas e solucionar problemas de forma eficiente.
  • Experiência em depuração de API Requests e problemas de respostas usando ferramentas como Charles, logs de rede ou métodos semelhantes;
  • Experiência com implementação e administração de ferramentas de monitoramento, registro e telemetria (por exemplo, Splunk, Prometheus, etc.).
  • Ingles avançado para escrita e conversação (obrigatório, projeto internacional).

title: Analista FinOps Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) FinOps Cloud que tenha olhar analítico e proatividade para gerenciar e otimizar custos relacionados à infraestrutura em nuvem. Essa pessoa será responsável por consolidar e apresentar dados financeiros e operacionais, garantindo clareza sobre os gastos da área e fornecendo insights estratégicos para a tomada de decisão.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Monitorar e analisar os custos da infraestrutura em Cloud e Datadog, identificando os principais ofensores e oportunidades de otimização.
  • Construir dashboards e relatórios financeiros que consolidem a visão de custos da área, garantindo transparência e controle.
  • Estruturar planilhas detalhadas com projeções e estimativas financeiras, facilitando o planejamento e a tomada de decisão.
  • Garantir a correta aplicação de TAGs nos recursos de Cloud para rastreamento preciso dos gastos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de desenvolvimento, operações e finanças para implementar práticas de FinOps e governança de custos.
  • Atuar de forma proativa, antecipando demandas e garantindo segurança nas informações para a liderança.
  • Preparar e apresentar análises estratégicas para a alta gestão, assegurando clareza sobre os investimentos da área.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Conhecimento básico em Cloud Computing para extração e análise de custos.
  • Experiência com Datadog para obter dados financeiros e de consumo.
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar os principais ofensores de custos.
  • Entendimento de conceitos financeiros para estruturação de planilhas e estimativas.
  • Habilidade para construir dashboards e relatórios gerenciais (ferramenta flexível).
  • Proatividade e autonomia para investigar, consolidar e reportar informações críticas.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para apresentar dados estratégicos para a alta gestão.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Salesforce
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions using Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Lightning Components.


  • Customize Salesforce objects, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.


  • Develop Apex classes, triggers, Visualforce pages, Lightning Web Components (LWC).

title: Google Ads Portfolio Manager MCC & Billing
description:
Esta função é destinada a profissionais que gerenciam portfólios de contas Google Ads com foco em controle de estrutura, faturamento e visibilidade financeira dentro de ambientes MCC.

Como Google Ads Portfolio Manager, você será responsável por supervisionar um conjunto de contas organizadas em MCCs, garantindo que estruturas de billing, acessos e fluxos financeiros estejam corretos e alinhados aos padrões da agência. O papel combina gestão operacional com responsabilidade financeira em escala.

Você atuará em parceria com equipes de paid media, operações e finanças para acompanhar investimentos, validar configurações de faturamento, apoiar reconciliação de faturas e manter transparência em todo o portfólio. A função exige organização, precisão e experiência em ambientes multi-conta.

As responsabilidades incluem gestão de portfólio em MCCs, controle de billing, monitoramento de gastos, alinhamento com equipes internas e manutenção da integridade operacional das contas.

O que esta posição oferece:

Gestão de portfólio de contas Google Ads em MCC

Responsabilidade sobre billing e controle financeiro

Colaboração direta com equipes de finanças e operações

Ambiente remoto com flexibilidade

Foco em governança e clareza operacional

Exposição a estruturas complexas e múltiplos clientes

Caminho de crescimento para cargos seniores de operações

  • Este cargo é ideal para profissionais detalhistas, orientados a processos e confortáveis em gerenciar billing e estruturas MCC dentro de um ambiente de agência.

title: Engenheiro OTM (Oracle Transportation Management)
description:
Engenheiro OTM (Oracle Transportation Management) Sr.


  • Data de Início: Imediata
  • Contrato: Longo Prazo
  • Horário de Trabalho: UTC – Sede em Dallas/TX/EUA
  • Modalidade: 100% remoto
  • Contrato de Trabalho: PJ ou via Cooperativa
  • Taxa Hora: A ser negociado


Descrição da Vaga:


Profissional responsável por projetar, implementar, manter e dar suporte às soluções Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), garantindo eficiência operacional, confiabilidade, integração com outros sistemas e aderência às melhores práticas de logística, transporte e cadeia de suprimentos. Este profissional atuará como referência técnica para o ambiente OTM, apoiando equipes de negócios, operações e técnicas.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Configurar, aprimorar e ajustar tecnicamente o Oracle Transportation Management.
  • Definir e implementar soluções alinhadas às estratégias de logística, transporte e distribuição.
  • Realizar análise de requisitos, desenho de processos e documentação técnica e funcional.
  • Executar troubleshooting, análise de performance e resolução de incidentes em ambientes OTM.
  • Apoiar processos de implementação, melhoria contínua e projetos de evolução.
  • Trabalhar em integrações com ERP, WMS, TMS externos e outras plataformas corporativas.
  • Garantir segurança, governança, qualidade de dados e melhores práticas de arquitetura.
  • Apoiar equipes de negócios, operações e TI no uso correto do OTM.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro OTM ou em projetos com Oracle Transportation Management.
  • Forte conhecimento nos módulos de planejamento, execução, tarifação e visibilidade de transporte.
  • Experiência em integração do OTM com outros sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência em desenho de soluções e análise funcional de processos logísticos.
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, suporte e sustentação do OTM.
  • Conhecimento em SFTP, Web Services, APIs, XML, SQL ou tecnologias de integração relacionadas.
  • Idioma: Inglês avançado é obrigatório


Requisitos Desejáveis:


  • Experiência em ambientes logísticos de alta complexidade.
  • Conhecimento em Oracle Cloud, OCI, Oracle Cloud ERP ou plataformas relacionadas.
  • Experiência em projetos internacionais ou multiculturais.
  • Certificações Oracle ou relacionadas à cadeia de suprimentos são um diferencial.


Soft Skills:


  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a soluções.
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação e capacidade de engajamento com equipes técnicas e de negócios.
  • Proatividade, capacidade de priorização e autonomia.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Mentalidade voltada a processos e foco em melhoria contínua.


Mais informações serão fornecidas na entrevista técnica.

title: Application Architect - Remote in Brazil
description:
Job Title: Applications Architect

Competency Level: C5


Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Applications Architect with strong expertise in application modernization and Azure PaaS platforms. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of application architecture, cloud migration strategies, and modern hosting approaches, along with proven leadership experience guiding and managing technical teams.

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead application architecture, design, and modernization initiatives for enterprise-scale applications.
  • Modernize and migrate applications from on-premises or legacy platforms to Azure PaaS .
  • Host, configure, and optimize applications on IIS and Azure services.
  • Design and implement solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure Container Instances .
  • Analyze application architecture, dependencies, and integrations to define optimal migration pathways.
  • Perform application performance assessments before and after migration .
  • Containerize web applications and services, and manage deployment on Kubernetes.
  • Design Azure Landing Zones and define the Azure target-state solution architecture based on customer infrastructure landscapes.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Data Platform, DevOps, and Integration teams to ensure cloud adoption aligns with best practices.
  • Ensure solutions align with Azure strategy, business objectives, application and infrastructure requirements, and overall value realization.
  • Lead and technically guide teams of 5+ members , providing mentorship and architectural direction.
  • Work closely with internal teams, customers, and project managers to gather requirements and propose effective migration solutions.
  • Prepare and deliver solution architectures, technical documentation, and presentations to stakeholders.


Primary Skills & Technical Expertise

  • 13+ years of hands-on experience in application development and modernization .
  • Strong web application development experience.
  • Hands-on experience developing and hosting applications on Azure PaaS .
  • Expertise in application hosting, configuration, and optimization on Azure.
  • Strong understanding of database connectivity and configuration .
  • Proven ability to analyze application dependencies and integration points.
  • Experience with containerization of frontend applications and web services.
  • In-depth knowledge of hosting and operating containerized applications on Kubernetes / AKS .
  • Strong understanding of application migration scenarios, strategies, and pathways.


Secondary Skills

  • Experience working with internal stakeholders, customers, and project managers to define migration requirements.
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure PaaS services.
  • Basic to intermediate understanding of containerization and AKS operations.


Soft Skills

  • Strong customer-facing skills with the ability to build and maintain client relationships.
  • Positive attitude with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage and lead customer discussions and technical calls.
  • Strong presentation skills for solution and architecture proposals.
  • Team-oriented mindset with strong collaboration skills.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Technology Stack / Languages

  • .NET
  • Java
  • Angular / React
  • Python

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Technical Project Manager

Competency: C5/C6 Overall 15+ years of cloud transformational & consulting projects migration experience. The purpose of this role is for managing all large-scale multiple Cloud transformation & Migrations projects within cloud practice.

The candidate must be dynamic, committed and capable of preparing/tracking & managing the Project schedules. Should have very good experience in project/program management especially on any cloud transformation /migration/consulting projects.

Primary skills:

Should have executed large scale Cloud Migrations, SQL , Windows, Apps services, AVS, AVD Migrations or Integrations and Transformations

Proven track record of driving major IT projects, managing multiple priorities simultaneously, setting timelines, holding people accountable and delivering projects on-time and on-budget.

Experienced in Cloud technologies and worked on DC migration to Cloud

Expertise in planning and managing multiple stakeholders including client, offshore and cross functional teams to deliver the transformations required

Understanding of Infrastructure background of Virtualization, Cloud technologies, compute, storage and Network

Secondary Skills:

Strong communication skills with effective and efficient stakeholder management

Excellent time management, prioritization and organizational skills.

Must have experience working with tight deadlines and handling escalations

Manage Governance, collate projects status & report at regular intervals to leadership team

Weekly cadence on project/program reviews and reporting to internal stakeholders

Track & report schedule and cost variance across projects

Identification of issues, risks and track till closure or mitigation/resolution of all cloud transformation projects

Certifications (Good to have)

Agile Management

PRINCE2/PMP (Preferred)

Any other program management certifications

Good Understanding on Key technologies (Good to have)

ADO or any project Management tools, Azure Cloud, Database, Networking, Virtualization, Database, public Cloud etc.,

title: Desenvolvedor Android - Estágio
description:
Buscamos Estagiário para Desenvolvimento Android para atuar nos principais e novos projetos da Leal Apps, visando garantir o melhor produto para os nossos usuários.


Você será responsável por:

  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de apps Android nativos;
  • Auxiliar na implementação de novas funcionalidades e correções de bugs;
  • Colaborar com o time de produto e design para transformar requisitos em soluções práticas;
  • Participar de dailies, plannings e revisões técnica;
  • Aplicar boas práticas recomendadas.


O que é necessário:

  • Conhecimento em linguagem de programação Java/Kotlin;
  • Conhecimento básico em Android Studio e ciclo de vida de Activities/Fragments;
  • Noções de arquitetura MVVM, ViewModel, LiveData;
  • Uso básico de Git para versionamento de código;
  • Conhecimento em Room, Hilt ou outras bibliotecas Android modernas;
  • Formação em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins;
  • Boa comunicação e proatividade para trabalho remoto em equipe;
  • Escrever código limpo, bem estruturado e documentado;


A Leal Apps é uma startup em crescimento que atua no desenvolvimento de aplicativos próprios na área de saúde e bem estar, que tem como missão ajudar pessoas a criarem hábitos saudáveis através de aplicativos na área fitness.

São mais de 5 milhões de pessoas com hábitos saudáveis utilizando nossos apps, e por isso, queremos contar com um desenvolvedor Android disposto a crescer conosco a cada dia mais!

title: Estagiário
description:
Descrição da Empresa

Somos uma empresa atuante na construção de casas populares (Minha Casa Minha Vida) , regularização de imóveis e desenvolvimento de loteamentos residenciais , oferecendo soluções completas em engenharia, planejamento urbano e organização técnica para viabilizar moradia acessível.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) / Assistente Técnico(a) para atuar no modelo híbrido , em Belém/PA , apoiando a equipe técnica e administrativa da empresa.

A vaga é ideal para quem possui conhecimento básico em AutoCAD , interesse na área de construção civil e deseja aprender, na prática, sobre projetos, documentação técnica e rotina administrativa de obras e loteamentos.

Responsabilidades
  • Apoio na elaboração e ajustes de projetos em AutoCAD ;
  • Auxílio na confecção de memoriais descritivos , mapas de localização e documentos técnicos;
  • Organização e atualização de planilhas de obra e controles administrativos;
  • Suporte às demandas administrativas da equipe técnica;
  • Organização de documentos e apoio em processos de regularização e obras;
  • Apoio presencial quando necessário, conforme rotina da equipe.
Requisitos
  • Conhecimento básico em AutoCAD ;
  • Conhecimento básico em Pacote Office (Excel e Word);
  • Organização, responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalho em equipe;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida em Belém/PA ;
  • Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver profissionalmente.
Diferenciais
  • Interesse por construção civil, habitação popular e urbanismo;
  • Noções iniciais de documentação técnica e obras;
  • Proatividade e comprometimento.

  • Cargo: Estagiário(a) / Assistente Técnico(a)
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido
  • Local: Belém – PA

  • Possibilidade de aumento conforme desempenho e evolução técnica

  • Ambiente internacional, multicultural e orientado à performance

title: Gerente Distrital de Vendas
description:
Job Description


Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente Distrital de Vendas.


Você se identifica com ambiente dinâmico, com empresas em momento de startup que proporcionam alto potencial de crescimento profissional?


Estamos em busca de Pessoas Campeãs que queiram se desafiar e estar conosco para alçar voos cada vez mais altos!


Responsabilidades:


  • Liderando um time direto, fica responsável pelos Canais de Distribuição, Redes e Território (Canal Independente)
  • Responsável pelo desenvolvimento das capacidades funcionais e competências do time, através das ferramentas disponibilizadas pela cia;
  • Ser corresponsável na definição de um GTM de vendas otimizada, eficiente e rentável para o cumprimento dos objetivos traçados; Identificando lacunas nas áreas de cobertura dentro do território e avaliando oportunidades de investimento em cobertura. (Gestão de White Space);
  • Gerir Sell In, Sell Out, Estoques e política comercial dos Canais de Redes e Distribuição;
  • Implementar, acompanhar e apoiar os planos (JBPs) dos parceiros de Distribuição e Redes;
  • Redes: Implementar, acompanhar e Liderar as estratégias dos trimestres para a ativação do portfólio de marcas em coordenando a execução das equipes de Venda incluindo política de varejo, planos de clientes por UF, DOH da UF;
  • Assegurar a execução do plano de ativação em linha com o orçamento, atuando rapidamente no caso de ações corretivas e influenciando todas as áreas envolvidas no alcance dos resultados;
  • Canal Independente (Território): Desenvolver, o canal do varejo independente através de um time de 2 gestores e mais de 20 executivos, buscando atingir a melhor distribuição numérica, faturamento, mix e evolução dos itens prioritários (lançamentos);


Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior Completo (Cursos de exatas: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm e etc.,);
  • Pós graduação (Diferencial)
  • Experiência Comercial (Indústrias de bens de consumo - indispensável);
  • Experiência em liderança de times comerciais (indispensável);
  • Experiência no Canal indireto Distribuição FMCG (indispensável).


Informações adicionais:


Benefícios:


  • Plano Médico e Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Ticket Refeição;
  • Veículo;
  • Cartão combustível
  • PPR


Buscamos pessoas que querem colocar a mão na massa e fazer acontecer para tornar as empresas do Grupo referência em inovação e no cuidado com as pessoas. Vem ser Grupo NC você também!


SOMOS LEGRAND


Há mais de 40 anos no mercado farmacêutico, o Legrand Pharma está entre os 15 maiores laboratórios do país (unidades). Com um amplo portfólio de produtos (mais de 300 apresentações), atua no segmento de OTCs, tarjados e genéricos, presente em mais de 90% das farmácias brasileiras com forte atuação nas categorias de tosse, gastrointestinal, vitaminas, dermatológicos e saúde feminina.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
We are hiring a full-time Salesforce Developer  to support a fast-moving merchant cash advance company. This role is focused on fixing, optimizing, and improving the Salesforce environment the sales team uses every day. You will handle UI updates, system configuration, integrations, and fast-turnaround fixes that directly impact how quickly deals move through the pipeline. Full-time. Fully remote. Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING.


Hours: 9am–5pm EST.

Salary: $4,000/mo


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Salesforce configuration: fields, formulas, layouts, list views, role hierarchy, and sharing settings
  • Set up and maintain integrations — especially telephony tools like RingCentral inside Salesforce
  • Improve UI and usability for reps, ensuring workflows are clear and easy to follow
  • Build small Lightning components or UI enhancements when needed
  • Troubleshoot and fix Lightning integration issues, permission problems, and visibility restrictions
  • Adjust and maintain workflow automation (Flow, processes, rules) to support the sales process
  • Update dashboards, create filtered list views, and improve record access structure
  • Build and refine CRM actions such as the “Next Opportunity” button and other quick actions
  • Handle fast-turnaround tasks when urgent fixes are needed (same-day or <30 minutes when possible)
  • Clean up confusing configurations, inconsistent UI, or broken logic
  • Document changes and communicate clearly with leadership about what was done and why


Key Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of Salesforce Admin or Developer experience
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Experience with Lightning UI (components, layouts, actions, navigation)
  • Ability to diagnose and fix permission issues, sharing rules, and record visibility
  • Comfortable maintaining and improving telephony integrations (RingCentral preferred)
  • Strong grasp of Salesforce automation: Flows, process automations, workflow rules
  • Able to move quickly, prioritize urgent fixes, and troubleshoot without hand-holding
  • Detail-oriented with clean documentation and high accuracy
  • Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet
  • Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with merchant cash advance companies
  • Background in CRM architecture or workflow optimization
  • Ability to advise on long-term Salesforce structure, not just fix short-term issues

description:
We are hiring a full-time Salesforce Developer  to support a fast-moving merchant cash advance company. This role is focused on fixing, optimizing, and improving the Salesforce environment the sales team uses every day. You will handle UI updates, system configuration, integrations, and fast-turnaround fixes that directly impact how quickly deals move through the pipeline. Full-time. Fully remote. Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING.


Hours: 9am–5pm EST.

Salary: $4,000/mo


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Salesforce configuration: fields, formulas, layouts, list views, role hierarchy, and sharing settings
  • Set up and maintain integrations — especially telephony tools like RingCentral inside Salesforce
  • Improve UI and usability for reps, ensuring workflows are clear and easy to follow
  • Build small Lightning components or UI enhancements when needed
  • Troubleshoot and fix Lightning integration issues, permission problems, and visibility restrictions
  • Adjust and maintain workflow automation (Flow, processes, rules) to support the sales process
  • Update dashboards, create filtered list views, and improve record access structure
  • Build and refine CRM actions such as the “Next Opportunity” button and other quick actions
  • Handle fast-turnaround tasks when urgent fixes are needed (same-day or <30 minutes when possible)
  • Clean up confusing configurations, inconsistent UI, or broken logic
  • Document changes and communicate clearly with leadership about what was done and why


Key Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of Salesforce Admin or Developer experience
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Experience with Lightning UI (components, layouts, actions, navigation)
  • Ability to diagnose and fix permission issues, sharing rules, and record visibility
  • Comfortable maintaining and improving telephony integrations (RingCentral preferred)
  • Strong grasp of Salesforce automation: Flows, process automations, workflow rules
  • Able to move quickly, prioritize urgent fixes, and troubleshoot without hand-holding
  • Detail-oriented with clean documentation and high accuracy
  • Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet
  • Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with merchant cash advance companies
  • Background in CRM architecture or workflow optimization
  • Ability to advise on long-term Salesforce structure, not just fix short-term issues

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Social Media Content Creator + Social Media Manager (Design, Copywriting & AI Video)
description:
Social Media Content Creator + Social Media Manager (Design, Copywriting & AI Video)
What you’ll own (end-to-end)

You’ll be responsible for producing and publishing high-quality social content that matches each brand’s style and speaks naturally to English-speaking audiences.

Your deliverables will include:

  • Carousels & static creatives (IG/LinkedIn/Facebook)


  • Short-form videos (Reels/TikTok/YouTube Shorts style)


  • English copywriting (captions, hooks, CTAs , campaign copy)


  • Hashtag strategy & posting (scheduling, formatting, consistency)


  • Visual assets for campaigns (ads, promos, launches, announcements)


Day-to-day responsibilities


  • Adapt quickly to each brand’s style guide (tone, visuals, formatting)
  • Create on-brand carousels (clean design, clear structure, strong hooks)
  • Use AI video generation + editing tools to produce short-form videos fast
  • Write native-level English captions that sound human, not translated
  • Manage posting: captions, hashtags, tagging, scheduling, basic QA
  • Keep content production organized (folders, naming, versions, approvals)
  • Deliver on deadlines with a reliable weekly output cadence


Must-have requirements (please don’t apply without these)

To be considered, you must be able to do all of the following:

✅ English copywriting: strong, natural writing for English-speaking audiences

✅ Design: ability to produce polished social visuals (especially carousels)

✅ AI video + content creation: comfortable using AI tools to generate/edit videos and adapt to brand style

✅ Social media management: posting/scheduling + hashtags + formatting + consistency

Tools you’ll likely use (examples)

You don’t need every tool listed-just show you can produce efficiently with your stack.

  • Design: Canva, Miro, Adobe (PS/AI), Figma (or equivalent)


  • Video: CapCut, Premiere, After Effects (or equivalent)


  • AI tools: Veo, Sora, Runway, Descript, HeyGen, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT (or similar)


  • Scheduling: Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Later, Hootsuite (or similar)


What “great” looks like in this role


  • You consistently deliver on time with minimal reminders


  • Your content matches the brand voice without needing heavy revisions


  • Captions read like they were written by a strong English marketer , not a translator


  • Posts look cohesive and high quality-not templated or generic


  • You can handle publishing details (hashtags, formatting, tagging) confidently


Bonus points (nice to have)
  • Experience building content from a brand style guide + reference posts
  • Experience working with agencies or multiple brands
  • Basic analytics/reporting (what worked, what to iterate)
  • Ability to propose content angles and hooks proactively


Compensation & Work Setup
  • Remote-friendly
  • Compensation based on skill + output (hourly or monthly retainer)
  • Potential for long-term work with steady content volume

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack Sênior (Angular e Java)
description:
Na CWI Software, estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (Angular + Java) para atuar 100% remoto, em contrato CLT, junto a um cliente do segmento financeiro de grande porte, referência no mercado nacional.


Você irá atuar em projetos de alta complexidade, com alto rigor técnico, segurança e escalabilidade, contribuindo diretamente para soluções críticas e estratégicas no setor financeiro.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter aplicações front-end utilizando Angular 16+.
  • Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços back-end em Java 21+ (Spring Boot).
  • Participar ativamente da definição de arquitetura, padrões técnicos e boas práticas.
  • Implementar interfaces responsivas, acessíveis e de alta performance, com foco em experiência do usuário.
  • Realizar code reviews e apoiar tecnicamente o time na evolução da qualidade do código.
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Contribuir com testes automatizados, documentação técnica e melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de UX/UI, backend, arquitetura, produto e negócio.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior.
  • Experiência avançada em Angular 16+.
  • Experiência com Java 21+, utilizando Spring Boot.
  • Conhecimento sólido em RxJS e State Management (NgRx, Akita, Signals, etc.).
  • Experiência com componentização, roteamento e arquitetura modular.
  • Boa compreensão de APIs REST, integração entre sistemas e microsserviços.
  • Vivência com testes unitários (Jest, Jasmine, Karma, JUnit, etc.).
  • Experiência com Git e ferramentas de build (Angular CLI, Webpack, Vite, Maven/Gradle).
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma, com visão crítica e foco em qualidade.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  • Vivência com micro frontends.
  • Experiência prévia no segmento financeiro.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações, performance e observabilidade.
  • Noções de UX, acessibilidade e boas práticas WCAG.
  • Atuação em projetos de larga escala e alto volume de usuários.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Na CWI Software, acreditamos que o sucesso dos nossos projetos está diretamente ligado ao desenvolvimento e bem-estar das pessoas. Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo e com reais oportunidades de crescimento profissional, valorizando a excelência técnica e a troca de conhecimento.


Vem construir soluções de alto impacto com a gente!

title: Portuguese Cardiologist Medical Students / Doctors
description:
Company Description

DeepLLMData specializes in empowering frontier models with human-generated expert data. Our expertise spans coding SFT, RLHF, STEM fields, PhD-level research, and domain-specific knowledge. We offer image and video annotators, as well as comprehensive data provisioning services for image and video-based projects. By using our precise and expert-guided data, we help innovate and advance AI systems.


Role Description

This is a remote, contract-based role for Portuguese-speaking Cardiologist Medical Students or Doctors. In this position, you will contribute to generating, reviewing, and enriching medical data specific to cardiology. Your tasks will involve utilizing your expertise in specialized areas of medicine, ensuring the accuracy and relevance of data across different cardiology subfields.


Qualifications

  • Specialized knowledge in Cardiology and related disciplines
  • Portuguese language proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking)
  • Attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and quality

title: Gynecologist - with Portuguese Language
description:
Company Description

DeepLLMData specializes in providing expert human-annotated data to enhance frontier machine learning models. Our expertise includes coding SFT and RLHF, as well as services from domain-specific experts in areas such as medicine, STEM, and mathematics. We also offer image and video annotation along with provisioning high-quality image and video datasets. Our commitment is to deliver precise and high-value data solutions for innovative AI applications.


We are looking for Gynecology specialization for LLM are looking for:

  • Gynecology's Medical Students (Years 4–6)
  • Medical Interns / Early Residents
  • Gynecologist

Work:

  • QA of clinical content (EHR, RX, diagnostics, research notes)

Requirements:

  • Gynecologist
  • Portuguese + good English comprehension
  • Accuracy, attention to detail
  • No prior AI experience needed

Type of Work:

  • Remote
  • Flexible hours (5–20 hrs/week)
  • Freelance / Independent contractor

title: Creative Producer (Design + Copywriting + AI Video) for Social & Campaigns
description:
We’re looking for a hands-on Creative Producer who can design , write , and produce scroll-stopping social content -fast-while staying 100% consistent with brand voice .


What you’ll own (deliverables)


You will be responsible for delivering ALL of the below:


1) Copywriting + captions (English)
  • Social captions that sound natural, on-brand, and conversion-friendly
  • Hooks, CTAs, and short ad copy variations
  • Light editing/polishing to match brand tone (not “AI-sounding”)


2) Social content production (AI + editing)
  • Short-form videos (Reels/TikTok/Shorts-style) using AI video generation tools + editing workflows
  • Content repurposing (turn long ideas into short clips, carousels, and posts)


3) Design for campaigns + marketing assets
  • Carousels (clean, modern, branded, readable)
  • Creative assets for ads , email warmups , newsletters , and promotional campaigns
  • Visual variations for testing (formats, messaging angles, layouts)


What success looks like in this role
  • You deliver high-quality creative on time -consistently
  • You can match a brand’s look and tone quickly (even if it’s niche or premium)
  • Your captions and copy feel native-level English (not awkward or generic)
  • Our content starts looking more polished, more clickable, and more “brand-safe” across channels


Must-have requirements (please don’t apply without these)

  • Strong English writing and communication (you can write for English-speaking audiences without heavy rewriting)
  • Proven ability to create carousels + short-form videos that match a brand style
  • Ability to do copywriting + design + video (this is not a “designer-only” role)
  • Comfortable using AI tools for ideation + video generation + faster production
  • A portfolio that shows real examples (not just mockups)


Nice-to-haves (not required, but a big plus)

  • Experience creating assets for paid ads (Meta/TikTok/YouTube)
  • Understanding of direct-response principles (hooks, clarity, benefit-led copy)
  • Motion graphics or advanced editing skills
  • Experience with email marketing creative (newsletters, warmups, promos)


Tools (examples - use what you’re best with)

Figma / Adobe / Canva • CapCut / Premiere • Runway / Descript / AI video tools • ChatGPT (or similar) for ideation + drafts

(We care about results and speed-tool choice is flexible.)


Pace & workflow expectations

  • Fast turnaround and proactive communication
  • Ability to take feedback and iterate quickly
  • You’ll receive brand references, creative direction, and examples-then you execute with minimal hand-holding

﻿

Not a fit if…
  • You only do one of these (design OR copy OR video). We need someone who can do all three.
  • You struggle to match brand style and need many rounds to “get it”
  • Your English writing needs heavy correction
  • You deliver late or go quiet when deadlines approach



If you’re a reliable creative who can ship on time , match brand voice accurately , and produce content that looks premium and reads naturally in English-apply now.

title: Customer Support Team Lead (German, French and English)_EverHelp
description:
EverHelp is part of the Genesis ecosystem — an international full-service IT company. More than 1,500 people in five countries create products for over 200 million monthly users. Genesis is one of the largest partners of Facebook, Google, Snapchat, and Apple in Eastern Europe, with an ecosystem that includes over 15 companies and an investment fund.

EverHelp is a fast-growing outsourcing customer support project within the Genesis ecosystem. Since launching in 2021, we’ve been providing professional support services for international B2B and B2C clients. Last year, the project demonstrated a +82% annual growth rate and maintained an employee satisfaction rate above 90%.

We’re currently expanding our team for one of our partners, and we’re looking for a Trilingual Customer Support Representative (English, French & German) to join our international customer care team.

If you can put yourself in the customers’ shoes, remain patient, empathetic, and cheerful — this role is for you!

Required experience and skills:
  • 2–3 years of experience in Customer Support or support operations;
  • Proven experience in team coordination, delegation, or people management;
  • Strong understanding of customer support operational metrics (CSAT, FRT, ART, Backlog, SLA/OLA);
  • Experience with reporting, data analysis, and root-cause analysis;
  • German — C1 and French — C1 (both written and spoken);
  • English — Upper-Intermediate (B2+) for client and internal communication;
  • High level of empathy, emotional intelligence, and customer-oriented mindset;
  • Strong communication maturity with the ability to set boundaries;
  • Ability to stay calm under pressure and manage escalations effectively;
  • Leadership skills: motivating the team, providing feedback, and developing people;
  • Proactive, solution-oriented approach and ownership mindset;
  • Experience with Zendesk or similar ticketing systems is a strong plus.
Your future responsibilities include:
  • Ensuring stable day-to-day operations of the Tier 1 support team and close collaboration with Tier 2;
  • Direct communication with customers: handling complex cases, escalations, and feedback;
  • Planning vacations and absences, ensuring balanced workload distribution within the team;
  • Conducting agent evaluations and performance reviews;
  • Delegating tasks and controlling SLA/OLA compliance;
  • Monitoring operational metrics (CSAT, FRT, ART, Backlog) and taking corrective actions;
  • Mentoring and onboarding agents, running regular 1:1 meetings;
  • Performing Quality Control evaluations and feedback sessions;
  • Improving support processes and creating/updating documentation;
  • Participating in incident management and coordinating internal and external communications.
Why EverHelp:
  • Leadership role with real influence on support processes and service quality;
  • Collaboration with a new international partner and exposure to complex, non-standard cases;
  • High level of autonomy and trust from management;
  • A strong, supportive, and ambitious team;
  • Stable full-time schedule: 8:00–17:00 CET, 1-hour break;
  • A dynamic international environment with continuous professional growth opportunities.
Career growth opportunities:

Further growth paths to be discussed individually based on performance and business needs.

Recruitment process:
  • Intro call;
  • Test assignment (3 days to complete);
  • Interview with Hiring Manager;
  • Bar-raising interview;

 Join EverHelp as a Customer Support Team Lead and take ownership of service quality, people development, and operational excellence in an international environment!

title: Customer Support Team Lead (German, French and English)_EverHelp
description:
EverHelp is part of the Genesis ecosystem — an international full-service IT company. More than 1,500 people in five countries create products for over 200 million monthly users. Genesis is one of the largest partners of Facebook, Google, Snapchat, and Apple in Eastern Europe, with an ecosystem that includes over 15 companies and an investment fund.

EverHelp is a fast-growing outsourcing customer support project within the Genesis ecosystem. Since launching in 2021, we’ve been providing professional support services for international B2B and B2C clients. Last year, the project demonstrated a +82% annual growth rate and maintained an employee satisfaction rate above 90%.

We’re currently expanding our team for one of our partners, and we’re looking for a Trilingual Customer Support Representative (English, French & German) to join our international customer care team.

If you can put yourself in the customers’ shoes, remain patient, empathetic, and cheerful — this role is for you!

Required experience and skills:
  • 2–3 years of experience in Customer Support or support operations;
  • Proven experience in team coordination, delegation, or people management;
  • Strong understanding of customer support operational metrics (CSAT, FRT, ART, Backlog, SLA/OLA);
  • Experience with reporting, data analysis, and root-cause analysis;
  • German — C1 and French — C1 (both written and spoken);
  • English — Upper-Intermediate (B2+) for client and internal communication;
  • High level of empathy, emotional intelligence, and customer-oriented mindset;
  • Strong communication maturity with the ability to set boundaries;
  • Ability to stay calm under pressure and manage escalations effectively;
  • Leadership skills: motivating the team, providing feedback, and developing people;
  • Proactive, solution-oriented approach and ownership mindset;
  • Experience with Zendesk or similar ticketing systems is a strong plus.
Your future responsibilities include:
  • Ensuring stable day-to-day operations of the Tier 1 support team and close collaboration with Tier 2;
  • Direct communication with customers: handling complex cases, escalations, and feedback;
  • Planning vacations and absences, ensuring balanced workload distribution within the team;
  • Conducting agent evaluations and performance reviews;
  • Delegating tasks and controlling SLA/OLA compliance;
  • Monitoring operational metrics (CSAT, FRT, ART, Backlog) and taking corrective actions;
  • Mentoring and onboarding agents, running regular 1:1 meetings;
  • Performing Quality Control evaluations and feedback sessions;
  • Improving support processes and creating/updating documentation;
  • Participating in incident management and coordinating internal and external communications.
Why EverHelp:
  • Leadership role with real influence on support processes and service quality;
  • Collaboration with a new international partner and exposure to complex, non-standard cases;
  • High level of autonomy and trust from management;
  • A strong, supportive, and ambitious team;
  • Stable full-time schedule: 8:00–17:00 CET, 1-hour break;
  • A dynamic international environment with continuous professional growth opportunities.
Career growth opportunities:

Further growth paths to be discussed individually based on performance and business needs.

Recruitment process:
  • Intro call;
  • Test assignment (3 days to complete);
  • Interview with Hiring Manager;
  • Bar-raising interview;

 Join EverHelp as a Customer Support Team Lead and take ownership of service quality, people development, and operational excellence in an international environment!

title: DevSecOps Engineer (Levels II & IV)
description:
Role: DevSecOps Engineers (Mid–Senior | Azure | AI Platforms)

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote in Brazil/Costa Rica/Argentina


About the Role

We are seeking a DevSecOps Engineers to support and scale secure, reliable delivery pipelines for enterprise AI and platform initiatives . This role embeds security, compliance, and operational excellence directly into the SDLC, working closely with platform and engineering teams.

Depending on experience, this position may align to a mid-level (DevSecOps II) or senior/architect-level (DevSecOps IV) scope. Leveling will be determined during the interview process.

This role supports internal platforms and assets that enable downstream client delivery and innovation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps
  • Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM
  • Embed security, compliance, and reliability controls into build and release workflows
  • Support or lead monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability
  • Collaborate with engineering teams on deployments and release readiness
  • (Senior-level scope) Define DevSecOps, SRE, and security standards across teams
  • (Senior-level scope) Lead security reviews, risk mitigation, and mentoring activities


Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of DevSecOps, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Engineering experience
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Azure DevOps (CI/CD pipelines)
  • Terraform and/or ARM templates
  • Git, YAML, PowerShell, Azure CLI
  • Working knowledge of Azure networking and identity fundamentals
  • Experience automating build, release, and deployment processes
  • Strong collaboration and documentation skills


Additional Qualifications for Senior Candidates (DevSecOps IV)

  • 10+ years of experience in DevSecOps, SRE, or cloud architecture roles
  • Enterprise-scale Azure architecture experience
  • Advanced knowledge of security, compliance, and risk management
  • Experience defining standards and guiding multiple teams or pods
  • Proven mentoring or technical leadership background
